purpose: Test whether bounding RTT_CTL UART7 polling prevents the D47 long-tail MAVLink heartbeat gap without changing ArduPilot layers above HAL_RTT/BSP.

source.base_head: a4da47f60d 记录D48D49 USB实验拒绝并恢复D47基线
source.change: Added usart_ll_tx_poll_timeout() and used it only for RTT_CTL UART7 telemetry.

flash.command: openocd -f interface/stlink.cfg -f target/stm32f7x.cfg -c init -c 'program build/rtt_cuav_v5/rtthread.bin 0x08008000 verify' -c 'reset run' -c shutdown

mavlink.note: After flash and OpenOCD reset run, only ST-Link and the CH340 debug serial device were present; the APM CUAV V5 CDC interface did not enumerate.

gdb.reset_timeline: reset halt started at bootloader PC 0x08000200, resume for 12s then halt found Handler HardFault at hardfault_hang.

decision.reason: D51 does not satisfy L0. The clean D51 build flashes successfully but the app CDC does not enumerate and OpenOCD/GDB repeatedly catches HardFault after reset.
decision.next_step: Remove the D51 source patch and restore a known runnable firmware before continuing USB long-tail work.
